scope: Single-GPU BF16 routed MoE GPU time; no model throughput, shared experts, routing selection or communication. Includes public-call GPU adapters and combine.
baseline_scope: Applicable and successfully validated runner-advertised tactics plus defaults; factorized runners can expose a ranked shortlist, not the full Cartesian space. Unsupported/failing native candidates are explicit exclusions. No all-FlashInfer optimum claim.
timing: 16 external-event-delimited individual invocations per graph. 18 samples per candidate, opposite orders, duplicate A/A captures and separate normal/reverse processes. Selection is frozen independently. Cold eviction is outside timed intervals.
qualification: 1% repeat/A-A/cross-process stability; same exact native minimizer (allowing exact ties) in both validation processes. Selected-pair and FC2-increment comparisons qualify independently. Differences below 1% are parity.
numerics: FP64 dot-product reference with BF16 intermediate/expert-output boundaries; unchanged 1% relative-L2 and 3% normalized-max limits. Three changed-input graph checks and a post-timing check in each validation process. Positive BF16-rounded scores; per-token unique expert IDs.
